ops.en: THE UNSTATED OFFENSE [G63-06/07]. chatu mashqe... LA-ADONEHEM — the lordship-word behind its prefix SOUNDS its aleph, one of the Masorah's SEVEN [VERIFIED: manifest G63-06, the compound half-vowel in-stream]; the token stands once in the Torah, its pair 'who say to their lords: bring, and let us drink' (Amos, named) — there over drink, here over drink: the fly in the cup [G63-07]. mashqe unjoined …

THE DOUBLY-FULL BAKERS [G63-01]. ve-al sar HA-OFIM — the bakers-word full with vav AND yod, ONCE in the Torah, at the pair's introduction; its four lean stations follow through the span and into 41:10 [VERIFIED: manifest G63-01].
THE CONVERGENCE. meqom asher YOSEF asur sham — the offenders land in Joseph's address; the bound-word's grammar continues 39:20's pair [G62-06 armed there, landing at 40:5].
THE SERVICE REPEATS. va-yifqod... va-yesharet otam — the appoint- verb and the serve-verb of Potiphar's house (39:4) recur inside the prison: the chapter's architecture is 39's, one level down.
THE PAIRED DREAMS. ish chalomo be-layla echad ish KE-FITRON chalomo — the letter grades the dreams by their interpretations before any interpreter speaks.
THE BOUND PAIR CLOSES [G62-06]. asher ASURIM be-vet ha-sohar — the bound-word's second and last Torah station (with 39:20): both are Joseph's prison; the third is the Psalm's release, named.

THE NOTICING [G63-08]. ve-hinam ZOAFIM — the downcast-word once in the Torah, its partner Daniel's food-worry (named): there over eating, here over eating. The turn of the whole cycle begins in a servant noticing two faces.
THE QUESTION. madua penekhem raim ha-yom — bet of 'his master's house' carrying the merkha-stroke, not maqqef, per MS [G63-11, asserted].

THE TELL-DEMAND. ha-lo le-ELOHIM pitronim — sapru-na li: interpretations assigned to God, the telling requested for himself; the span's only spoken imperative. The tell-word's Masorah triple (told here, 'TELL among the nations his glory' twice, named) rides the Kitzur: for this telling his glory was told before Pharaoh.
TOLD. va-yesaper sar ha-mashqim — the tell-demand discharges in the next verse; ve-hine joined by maqqef per MS [G63-11, asserted].

THE BRANCHES AGAINST BOTH CODICES [G63-02/03]. u-va-gefen shelosha SARIGIM — the Hilleli wrote it doubly full, the Yerushalmi codex doubly lean, and ALL the books (MS: 'like neither of them') full- first-lean-second — SNAPSHOT with the books [VERIFIED: manifest G63-02]; and at the interpretation (40:12) the word FLIPS to lean- first-full-second, both stations once each [G63-03]. u-va-gefen's gimel…
THE CUP'S TRIPLE. ve-khos paro be-yadi — Pharaoh named three times in the one dream-verse (cup, cup, palm): the dreamer's office told in its instrument; the hand-word continues its arc from ch. 39.

THE FORMULA. ze pitrono — the this-is-its-interpretation formula debuts, to be repeated verbatim at 40:18: two dreams, one grammar, opposite verdicts. ha-sarigim here written with its yod flipped [G63-03].

THE STILL-WORD FULL [G63-04]. BE-OD sheloshet yamim — the od-word full with vav as the Ramah's rule requires (its only two lean stations stand at his two signs, 8:22 and 19:12, census exact) [VERIFIED: manifest G63-04]. va-hashivkha with patach against its segol-twin in the curses (Deut 28:68) — the Masorah's hooks-of-the- pillars sign, named [G63-12].

ONE IDIOM, THREE VERBS [claim G63-14]. "Pharaoh will LIFT YOUR HEAD" is rendered three different ways by the received translation across this chapter — TAKE UP for the butler (restoration), REMOVE for the baker (beheading), and REMEMBER at the feast where the verse counts both together. The pun the two dreams turn on is not translated but decided, one seat at a time, so the interpretation is writt…

THE REMEMBER-DEMAND. ki im-zekhartani itkha... ve-hizkartani el paro ve-hotzetani — remember, mention, bring out: Joseph's one petition in the cycle, pushed on the man whose head is about to be lifted. It stays OPEN past the span's end — and the closing verse narrates its non-satisfaction in so many words (40:23): the machine's only demand whose forgetting is itself a fact in the stream [watch: 41…

TWO YEARS FOR TWO WORDS [claim G63-13, machine-checked]. The remembering-root stands TWICE in this one verse — "REMEMBER me with you" and "and MENTION me to Pharaoh" — and the reading prices one added year of imprisonment for each, which is exactly the two years the next chapter opens by counting. A trust-audit charged at the ink: the request that leaned on a man rather than on Heaven is billed wo…

THE NAMELESS ACCOUNT. gunov GUNAVTI — the doubled passive: stolen, twice said, no thief named; samu oti BA-BOR — the pit-word returns for the prison (37:24's word re-used by its victim): Joseph's whole history told without accusing a brother. shemo's end-stress ('the Masorah: none other so') files at 40:15, named [G63-12].

THE BYSTANDER'S TOV [G63-10]. va-yar sar ha-ofim KI TOV patar — the span's one tov-token is a bystander's judgment, not an oracle's verdict: the corpus's TEST register stays silent (letter-note — the first ki-tov in the corpus spoken by an onlooker). And MS's books rule ki 'with GALGAL, not maqqef': the unjoined half verified, SNAPSHOT writing the munach where the Sephardic books write the wheel —…
THE GIVE-AWAY. ve-ha-OF okhel otam — the fowl-word of gen_05's all- full rule feeding from a doomed man's head: the dream betrays its verdict in one clause the dreamer does not read.
ONE GRAMMAR, TWO VERDICTS. ze pitrono — word for word the cupbearer's formula (40:12): the letter gives both men the same opening and lets the next verse divide them.
THE IDIOM SPLITS. yisa faro et roshkha ME-ALEKHA — the head-lifting of 40:13 plus two words (from-off-you): the letter executes the baker inside the cupbearer's own phrase. be-od full again [G63-04].

THE GRAMMARIAN CORRECTED [G63-05]. yom HULEDET et paro — Radak's Michlol ruled the birth-word full like Ezekiel's; the Masorah, every book, the Hilleli, and the Ramah write it LEAN — and Radak retracted in his Shorashim. SNAPSHOT lean, once in the Torah [VERIFIED: manifest G63-05]. Both heads lifted in one clause; the next two verses divide the liftings.
RESTORED AS SAID. va-yashev... va-yiten ha-kos al kaf paro — 40:13's words re-walked; the books that err writing 'et ha-kos' here corrected by MS, named [G63-12].

THE LETTER VERIFIES. KA-ASHER PATAR LAHEM YOSEF — the narrative's own as-he-interpreted clause: the span tests Joseph's word against events and records the match in four words. sar with the merkha- stroke, not maqqef [G63-11, asserted].

THE NARRATED FORGETTING [G63-09]. ve-LO ZAKHAR sar ha-mashqim et yosef va-yishkachehu — the not-remembered adjacency stands once in the Torah, and the Kitzur chains it: the butler forgot Joseph, Joash forgot Jehoiada, 'He remembered not His footstool' [VERIFIED: manifest G63-09]. The machine closes with the remember-demand OPEN and the letter itself stating the failure — doubled (did not remember,…
